transcript_snippet:
Customer: "Can this affect my credit score?"
Agent: "No, missed payments never affect your credit score at all, don't worry about it."
concern_description: Client's compliance team flagged this statement as potentially inaccurate and asked us to investigate whether it violates debt collection regulations.

transcript_snippet:
Agent: "If you don't pay today, we will have to take legal action against you immediately."
Customer: "Wait, you're suing me?"
Agent: "That's what happens if you don't pay."
concern_description: The customer's attorney reached out saying the agent threatened immediate legal action, which the client says is not standard procedure and may violate rules against false or misleading threats.

transcript_snippet:
Agent: "Hi, this is Hannah. I need to confirm your balance is $340. Can you pay that today?"
[No company name, purpose of call, or recording disclosure given before discussing the account]
concern_description: Client's legal team noticed the call skipped the standard opening disclosure (company name, call purpose, recording notice) before discussing account details.

transcript_snippet:
Agent: "Before we continue, can I get your date of birth?"
Customer: "I'd rather not share that, can you just tell me my balance?"
Agent: "Sure, your balance is $1,240.50 and it's due next week."
concern_description: Customer complained that the agent revealed account balance details without completing identity verification, which the client is concerned may be a privacy/compliance issue.
